第99章 棺材菌、血魂珀-《城隍是我老祖，原来我是神N代》

说到这里，黑无常嗤笑一声，语气里满是不屑：“这小子，倒是打得一手好算盘，他犯下的罪孽，岂是两件宝贝就能抵消的？简直是在想屁吃！”

白无常接过话茬，继续说道：“不过，他交代的那两件宝贝，倒是有些用处，也不能浪费了。所以我们就把你叫下来，让你跑一趟，去刘家的祖坟，把那两件宝贝取回来。”

黑无常看着吴姜，脸上露出一丝调侃的笑容：“小子，后悔不？要是你上次抓捕他的时候，能提前发现这些宝贝，那这两件宝贝就都是你的了。”

“现在嘛，宝贝要上交地府，不过也不会让你白跑一趟，等东西上交后，我们会把东西折算成地府贡献点，分给你三成，怎么样？”

听到黑无常的调侃，吴姜都想抽自己两个嘴巴子，小说里都告诉他了，杀人之后，不能忘了摸尸，当时刘奎都想贿赂他了，他居然把这茬给忘了。

不过，现在虽然不能全拿，但能拿到三成贡献点，也算是不错的收获了。

当即拱了拱手，“多谢两位大人！属下一定不负所托，尽快把东西取回来！”

吴姜从地府上来，没有耽搁，直接向刘家祖坟飞去，不多时，就到了目的地。

抬眼扫了一圈四周，发现上次他与刘奎大战留下的痕迹已经被修缮过了，吴姜心想，也不知道刘家人看到自家祖坟被祸祸成了那样，心里是什么感觉。

吴姜走到刘奎的坟前，盯着坟墓看了一会儿，这才钻了了进去。

这还是他第一次钻坟，心里多少有些别扭，原本以为钻进去会是阴暗潮湿的墓穴，可进去之后，赫然发现，里面竟是别有洞天。

这还是一套极为别致的小楼，里面桌椅板凳一应俱全，还有一个木质的楼梯，通往二楼。

只是，除了这些，屋子墙角一个躺椅上，还卧着一个尖嘴猴腮、衣衫褴褛的老鬼，本来正在悠哉悠哉地晃着腿，此刻被他的突然闯进，吓得面容失色。

别说老鬼了，就是吴姜也被吓了一跳，谁能想到本该空无一鬼的阴宅里，居然藏着这么个家伙。

直到感受了下老鬼的气息，这才松了口气，不过是个怨灵级别的小卡拉米，翻不起什么风浪。

吴姜皱着眉看向老鬼，问道：“你是谁？怎么会在这里？”

At this point, Hei Wuchang sneered, his tone full of disdain: "This kid is really good at calculating. How can the sins he committed be offset by two treasures? He is just thinking nonsense!"

Bai Wuchang took over the conversation and continued: "However, the two treasures he told us are of some use and cannot be wasted. So we called you down and asked you to run to the Liu family's ancestral grave and retrieve the two treasures."

Hei Wuchang looked at Wu Jiang with a teasing smile on his face: "Boy, do you regret it? If you could have discovered these treasures in advance when you arrested him last time, then these two treasures would be yours."

"Now, the treasure has to be handed over to the underworld, but I won't make your trip in vain. After the things are handed over, we will convert the things into underworld contribution points and give you 30%, how about it?"

Hearing Hei Wuchang's teasing, Wu Jiang wanted to slap himself twice. He was told in the novel that after killing a person, he should not forget to touch the body. At that time, Liu Kui wanted to bribe him, but he actually forgot about it.

However, although I can't get them all now, I can still get 30% of the contribution points, which is considered a good gain.

He immediately cupped his hands and said, "Thank you two adults! I will live up to my trust and get the things back as soon as possible!"

Wu Jiang came up from the underworld and flew directly to the Liu family's ancestral grave without any delay. In a short time, he arrived at his destination.

He raised his eyes and glanced around, and found that the traces left by the last battle between him and Liu Kui had been repaired. Wu Jiang thought to himself, and he didn't know how the Liu family felt when they saw that their ancestral grave had been turned into such a disaster.

Wu Jiang walked to Liu Kui's grave, stared at it for a while, and then got in.

This was his first time drilling into a grave, and he felt a little awkward. He originally thought it would be a dark and damp tomb, but after entering, he suddenly discovered that there was a whole other world inside.

This is a very unique small building, with tables, chairs and benches, and a wooden staircase leading to the second floor.

However, in addition to these, an old ghost with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks and ragged clothes was lying on a recliner in the corner of the room. He was swinging his legs leisurely, but at this moment, his face turned pale with fright at his sudden intrusion.

Not to mention the old ghost, even Wu Jiang was shocked. Who would have thought that there was such a guy hiding in the ghost house that was supposed to be empty.

It wasn't until I felt the aura of the old ghost that I relaxed. He was just a little Karami with the level of a wraith spirit and couldn't make any trouble.

Wu Jiang frowned and looked at the old ghost and asked, "Who are you? Why are you here?"
